architecture.summary: The existing web owner replaces the long Audit explanation with the owner-requested authority/privacy warning and exposes Axiom or Custom selection. Its private form parser requires a valid dataset for Axiom, excludes a dataset for Custom, and permits only Bearer writes. The page maps the choice to the existing optional dataset field; the settings service, store, sender, public declarations, components, edges, registry diagrams, containers and deployment stay unchanged. Existing None-auth rows remain readable and unchanged until an explicit Bearer Save; old rendered forms fail closed and require reload. A static hash-pinned script controls the dataset field only on Audit pages; Members retains script denial. Admin, origin, CSRF, revision, encrypted token retention and saved-Test rules remain in place. Registry prose and the active plan now state this UI behavior. This local credential-form and CSP change requires T1 Team review; it changes no separate supported portal/client protocol or external integration.
